scope: Self-timed 6T SRAM with the standard 2:1 column mux; frozen peripheral/buffer W/L; full32x32 post-layout anchor; explicitly estimated larger classes

nominal_patterns.seq: Four accesses: write1/read1/write0/read0 on the last row; native data stimulus
nominal_patterns.mixed: Four accesses from the retained eight-entry alternating-data, opposite-row pattern; both mux inputs
nominal_patterns.first_read: First access reads background0 on the last row before any write, then toggles row/data/mux input
nominal_patterns.idle: First read, deselected capture, write on opposite row, deselected capture; input toggles continue

network_model.extraction: Calibre distributed R+C+CC from DRC0/LVS CORRECT complete macro
network_model.supply: Extracted VDD/VSS mesh, every macro supply pin fed; kit contact/via resistance unchanged
network_model.initial_guess: Schematic .IC operating point, released for transient; startup deviation checked

offset_study.corners: Five worst-PVT points above plus TT1V25C
offset_study.parasitics: Full extracted compact mux/sense slot, no RC reduction
offset_study.bar: max(abs(mu)+6sigma+Vsys,0.10VDD); nominal1.5bar, per-deviceMC1bar, correct polarity and positive lead

mismatch.scope: Every retained logical cell, replica, controller and peripheral MOS; split physical fingers share a logical draw

clock_policy: ceil_to50ps(capture_to_full_recovery*(1+0.10)); separate absolute read deadline from capture50%; budgets contain sampled mismatch; larger-model uncertainty explicit
required_checks: One phase per selected capture and no rearm with CLK held high
No PRE overlap with WL/write/sense; no simultaneous write/sense; far ISO90 before enable10
Write drivers cover physical WL tail; read ISO release waits WL off
All decoder outputs settled before WL admission; first-read regression includes unselected rows
SA rails valid at completion/through active footer; output and cell data retained through deadline and next capture
Read/write completion allowance at least1.5 measured data-resolution interval
Full recovered state including latent guards/timers before capture
A shorter positive-period screen and an intentional too-short negative control

large_array_method.scope: Estimates/extrapolation authorized by user; historical g15 segments, actual frozen loads, measured decoder coupons and conditional cell/timer bounds; not new large-macro post-layout qualification

single_operation_runtime.check: Both access-validity and distributed-precharge scalar gates cover the final capture and its complete recovery; checked against actual Xyce measures as well as waveforms
single_operation_runtime.cases: SS8x8, localRC off/on at5.65ns/3.50ns; case cycles2 is accepted only for the native two-access C1 operations
single_operation_runtime.state_measure: VRECOVERY_ERROR_<cycle> repeats the complete pre-capture boundary vector at the clamped recovery endpoint, with0.1VDD control-state tolerance; VRESTORE_ERROR retains its separate0.02VDD bitline tolerance
negative_fidelity_cases: Hold read_resolved or write_resolved high after the final access while data and bitlines remain correct
Hold a guard pre_on_delayed low after the final access; both runtime and waveform gates must reject it

compact32.basis: Measured extracted nominal + matched per-corner MC ratio, raised by physicalSSspot

schematic32.basis: Actual32SS anchors, all-corner8 reference/mismatch and explicit conditional reserve

clock_baseline_binding: Immutable sizing lookup and normalized buffer/decoder policy, periphery, PDK content, actual physical context and current replica/guard/completion refs; cell candidates retain the frozen baseline
